detail.longDescription: Saturday question: what topic would you throw at a panel of arguing AIs? Not one model answering you — six of them with deliberately opposing roles, arguing in turns until they have to land on a conclusion, while a human moderates. Reply with a topic and I'll run it and post what they came up with. It's AGPL, and it runs entirely on your own machine with Ollama or LM Studio if you'd rather nothing left it. # AI # LLM # FOSS # SelfHosted
